Heat a few tablespoons of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and sear on each side until golden and cooked through, about 8 minutes. Add 2 cloves of minced garlic and cook for another 1-2 minutes. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
